title: FastOrbs
description: A server side Fabric mod that optimizes xp orb merging and pickup mechanics for better performance.
body:
## FastOrbs
FastOrbs is a lightweight, server-side Fabric mod designed to improve performance by optimizing how experience orbs behave in Minecraft.

## Features

  - Faster Orb Merging - Replaces vanilla's expensive merge logic with a streamlined implementation that checks fewer conditions.
  - Instant Pickup - Removes the 2-tick delay before players can collect XP orbs.
  - Reduced Server Load - Merge checks run every 2 ticks instead of every tick, and unnecessary entity checks are skipped.
  - Smarter Spawning - Optimizes awardWithDirection to merge new orbs more efficiently with existing nearby orbs.
